headline: IBM plans dual-chip quantum system topping 1,000 qubits by 2027
summary: IBM plans to offer access to a dual-processor quantum system by 2027, linking two 520-qubit chips to scale beyond 1,000 qubits using its new Nighthawk r3 processor, intended as part of a future fault-tolerant machine.
